suggest.ext-xdebug: Required only for PHPUnit code-coverage reports and the `pdepend` build target.
suggest.phploc/phploc: Report-only build target. Install standalone (PHIVE or a separate composer.json) - its sebastian/* dependencies are version-locked to a PHPUnit major and conflict with ours.
suggest.sebastian/phpcpd: Report-only build target. Install standalone, same version-lock conflict as phploc.
suggest.pdepend/pdepend: Report-only build target; also needs ext-xdebug for coverage input.
suggest.apigen/apigen: Required only for the `phing apigen` documentation target.
suggest.ncuesta/pinocchio: Required only for the `phing annotated` documentation target.
suggest.mayflower/php-codebrowser: Required only for the `phing codebrowser` build target.
